notes.title: RELEASE OF THE SECOND CHAPTER IN DLC!
notes.notes:
It is with great excitement that we announce the release of the first chapter of "A Steak Temple Panic"!

This is our second game as an independent developer, and we put all our heart into it!

[b]Don't forget to leave us a positive review![/b]

It will help us a lot to get known!

A huge thanks for your support!

notes.title: Only a few days left before the first FREE chapter release !
notes.notes:
In this cooperative narrative game, you have the choice to interpret your character as you wish!

For that, you will have the opportunity, during the main dialogues, to choose between four emotions:
- [b]anger[/b]
-[b] sadness[/b]
- [b]joy[/b]
-[b] remain neutral[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/15a28f171648a153cec0c8ee64dfcf9bbd9cc9bb.png[/img]

[b]These choices have no impact on the story, but rather on the way you interpret your character![/b]

Try different combinations, they are always very funny!

notes.title: Only one week left before the release of the first FREE chapter!
notes.notes:
How to play "A Steak Temple Panic" ?

"A Steak Temple Panic" is a cooperative adventure for [b]two players![/b]

The player who plays as Bob plays with the[b] keyboard[/b] only.

He uses the WASD keys and the arrow keys 
Yes, he plays with [b]BOTH HANDS ON THE KEYBOARD[/b]!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/fb650fde81302aa33ed403b977e7da5c83311c42.png[/img]

The player who plays Jenn plays with the [b]mouse [/b]only! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/87238224fa2d187ed39b697fba2b9bdf441d1dbe.png[/img]

No it's ok with only one hand...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399617/7746be11feec7ac83f4f9f97a418aeff51362b88.png[/img]

Attention, [b]EVEN THE WHEEL IS USED![/b]

notes.title: First FREE chapter RELEASE !
notes.notes:
[b]STOP WHATEVER YOU'RE DOING !!!![/b]

It's official, today is the release of the first "A Steak Temple Panic" FREE chapter !

Instructions for a night full of laughter:

1 - Call a friend

2 - Take a bag of crisps and fizzy drinks (healthier stuff is also allowed).

3 - Try out this crazy cooperative adventure that made all the playtesters howl with laughter !!!!!!!

notes.title: New trailer ! And new screenshots ! Release date announcement !
notes.notes:
New trailer ! And new screenshots!

Check out the two-player co-op game that made playtesters howling with laughter!

The first FREE chapter of "A Steak Temple Panic" will be released on October 4th! 

The second chapter, as DLC, will arrive on October 27th for €1.99!

That's not even the price of your steak sauce!
